title: Uncontrolled Blood
summary: Surging to 25% Synchronization, Ha-Jun transforms into a horned berserk demon and violently overpowers Rank-A Captain Baek. On the verge of an accidental slaughter, Min-Jae's desperate cry reaches Ha-Jun's human soul—allowing him to redirect the hellfire blast and shatter the campus dome.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands inside a crater of swirling black-violet hellfire; his school blazer is shredded, revealing glossy obsidian crystalline scales across his chest.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands inside a crater of swirling black-violet hellfire; his school blazer is shredded, revealing glossy obsidian crystalline scales across his chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ghumti hui kali-bangni narkankaal ki aag ke gaddhe ke andar khada hai; uska school blazer kata hua hai, jisse uski chhati par chamakdar obsidian crystaliy paraten dikhai de rahi han.

panels.action: Two curved, razor-sharp obsidian horns crown Ha-Jun's head, crackling with violet lightning and drifting purple embers.
panels.prose_en: Two curved, razor-sharp obsidian horns crown Ha-Jun's head, crackling with violet lightning and drifting purple embers.
panels.prose_hi: Do ghumavdar, ustra-nukile obsidian seeng ha-jun ke sir ka taj banate han, baingani bijli aur bahte baingani angaron ke saath kadkadate hue.

panels.action: Extreme macro: All human eye whites are gone—only pitch-black sclera with burning crimson-violet supernova rings remain.

dialogue.text: Insaaniyat khatam ho chuki thi... sirf shaitan bacha tha.

panels.prose_en: Extreme macro: All human eye whites are gone—only pitch-black sclera with burning crimson-violet supernova rings remain.
panels.prose_hi: Atyadhik macro: sabhi manav aankhon ka safed bhag chala gaya hai - keval jalte hue lal-bangni supernova chhalle ke saath gahre kale shwetpatal bache han.

panels.shot: mark of death vaporizing into gold dust
panels.action: The golden execution cross branded into his crystalline gauntlet cracks and disintegrates into harmless golden dust under monstrous mana.
panels.prose_en: The golden execution cross branded into his crystalline gauntlet cracks and disintegrates into harmless golden dust under monstrous mana.
panels.prose_hi: Swarn nishpaadan cross uske crystaliy gauntlet daraaron mein branded ho gaya aur rakshasi man ke neeche hanirahit sunhari dhul mein vighatit ho gaya.

panels.action: Captain Baek takes an involuntary backward step, his massive claymore shivering in his trembling palms: '25% Synchronization already?!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh koi aam bacha nahi hai... yeh True Monarch hai!

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek takes an involuntary backward step, his massive claymore shivering in his trembling palms: '25% Synchronization already?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak ek anaichhik peeche ki or kadam uthata hai, uski kampati hatheliyon mein uski vishal mitti kamp rahi hai: '25% sinkronization pehle se hi?!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his head; when he exhales, superheated violet plasma mist billows from his teeth, melting the wet turf into liquid slag.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tilts his head; when he exhales, superheated violet plasma mist billows from his teeth, melting the wet turf into liquid slag.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna sir jhukata hai; jab wah sans chhodta hai, to uske daaton se atyadhik garm baingani plasma dhundh nikalti hai, jo gili turf ko taral slag mein pighla deti hai.

panels.action: Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN! APNE HOSH MEIN RAHO! AGAR ASMODAIUS NE TUMHARA DIMAAG CHHEEN LIYA TOH POORA SHEHAR RAAKH HO JAYEGA!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Hosh mein aao! Poora shehar tabah ho jayega!

panels.prose_en: Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN! APNE HOSH MEIN RAHO! AGAR ASMODAIUS NE TUMHARA DIMAAG CHHEEN LIYA TOH POORA SHEHAR RAAKH HO JAYEGA!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro bhay se chillata hai: 'ha-jun! apne hosh mein raho! agar asmodiyas ne tumhara dimag chheen liya to pura shahar rakh ho jaega!'.

panels.action: Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human soul is trapped in a screaming crimson vortex, desperately fighting against demonic instinct.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ruk jao... mujhe kisi ko nahi maarna...!

panels.prose_en: Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human soul is trapped in a screaming crimson vortex, desperately fighting against demonic instinct.
panels.prose_hi: Uske dimag ke ander, ha-jun ki manav aatma ek chillate hue gahre bhanwar mein fans gai hai, jo rakshasi pravritti ke khilaf sakht ladai kar rahi hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun vanishes with zero wind resistance or acoustic tell; the air simply implodes where he was standing.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun vanishes with zero wind resistance or acoustic tell; the air simply implodes where he was standing.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun shunya vayu pratirodh ya dhwanik prabhav ke saath gayab ho jata hai; jahan wah khada tha vahan hawa bus fat jaati hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun appears inches from Baek's face, his jagged crystalline claw swinging horizontally with decapitating force.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun appears inches from Baek's face, his jagged crystalline claw swinging horizontally with decapitating force.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bake ke chehre se kuch inch ki doori par dikhai deta hai, uska dantedar crystaliy panja sir kaatne ki shakti ke saath kshaitij roop se jhool raha hai.

panels.action: Baek throws his holy claymore across his chest in a desperate flat parry; the collision rings like a church bell.
panels.prose_en: Baek throws his holy claymore across his chest in a desperate flat parry; the collision rings like a church bell.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne ek hatash sapat pairi mein apne pavitra clamor ko apni chhati par fenk diya; takkar church ki ghanti ki tarah bajti hai.

panels.shot: holy wings shattering into light feathers
panels.action: The concussive shockwave completely shatters both of Captain Baek's golden holy wings into thousands of dissolving feathers.
panels.prose_en: The concussive shockwave completely shatters both of Captain Baek's golden holy wings into thousands of dissolving feathers.
panels.prose_hi: Hilane wali shockwev captain bake ke donon sunhare pavitra pankhon ko hajaron ghulte pankhon mein puri tarah se tod deti hai.

panels.action: Baek's 220-pound armored body is blasted backward through the brick wall, through two classrooms, and out onto the tennis courts.
panels.prose_en: Baek's 220-pound armored body is blasted backward through the brick wall, through two classrooms, and out onto the tennis courts.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ke 220 pound ke bakhtarband shareer ko int ki deewar ke madhyam se, do kakshaon ke madhyam se, aur tennis court mein peeche ki or uda diya jata hai.

panels.action: Baek crashes into the chain-link fence, tearing the steel mesh; he coughs a heavy mouthful of blood, ceremonial coat shredded.
panels.prose_en: Baek crashes into the chain-link fence, tearing the steel mesh; he coughs a heavy mouthful of blood, ceremonial coat shredded.
panels.prose_hi: Bak steel ki jaali ko phaadate hue chen-link baad se takra jata hai; wah bhari matra mein khoon khansta hai, aupcharik coat cut jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun descends from the sky like a fallen black star, trailing twin ribbons of violet fire and black lightning.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun descends from the sky like a fallen black star, trailing twin ribbons of violet fire and black lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek gire hue kale taare ki tarah aakash se utarta hai, baingani aag aur kali bijli ke judwan ribbon ke pichhe.

panels.action: Ha-Jun lands and slams his palm down: Dozens of 15-foot crystalline blood spears erupt from the concrete, pinning Baek's limbs and armor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands and slams his palm down: Dozens of 15-foot crystalline blood spears erupt from the concrete, pinning Baek's limbs and armor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun utarta hai aur apni hatheli neeche patak deta hai: darjanon 15 foot ke crystaliy rakt bhale concrete se futate han, jo bak ke angon aur kavach ko jakad dete han.

panels.action: Baek hangs pinned against the fence by blood spears, claymore knocked 20 feet away, blood dripping from his lips.
panels.prose_en: Baek hangs pinned against the fence by blood spears, claymore knocked 20 feet away, blood dripping from his lips.
panels.prose_hi: Bak khoon ke bhale se baad ke khilaf latak gaya, clamor 20 feet door ja gira, uske hothon se khoon tapak raha tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands over Baek, condensing a pulsating sphere of black-and-violet Abyssal Hellfire in his palm, aimed at Baek's forehead.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands over Baek, condensing a pulsating sphere of black-and-violet Abyssal Hellfire in his palm, aimed at Baek's forehead.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bake ke upar khada hai, apni hatheli mein kale aur baingani abisal helfier ke ek spandanshil gole ko sanghanit kar raha hai, jiska uddeshya bake ke mathe par hai.

panels.action: Baek looks directly into the hellfire sphere, refusing to beg: 'Mujhe maar daalo, demon. Lekin Bureau tumhe kabhi nahi chhodega.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Mujhe maar daalo. Bureau tumhe dhoond nikalega.

panels.prose_en: Baek looks directly into the hellfire sphere, refusing to beg: 'Mujhe maar daalo, demon. Lekin Bureau tumhe kabhi nahi chhodega.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak sidhe narkankaal ki or dekhta hai aur bheekh maangane se inkar karta hai: 'mujhe maar dalo, danav. lekin bureau tumhe kabhi nahin chhodega.'.

panels.shot: min-jae limping onto tennis court shouting
panels.action: Min-Jae limps through the torn fence, clutching his bruised ribs, crying through his cracked glasses: 'HA-JUN! RUK JAO!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN! RUK JAO! USSE MAT MAARO!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae limps through the torn fence, clutching his bruised ribs, crying through his cracked glasses: 'HA-JUN! RUK JAO!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je fati hui baad ke madhyam se langdate hue, apni chotil pasliyon ko pakdkar, apne toote hue chashme ke madhyam se rote hue: 'ha-jun! 'ruk jao!!'

panels.shot: horned head turning alien cold stare
panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly turns his horned head toward Min-Jae; his pitch-black eyes look completely cold, predatory, devoid of human recognition.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slowly turns his horned head toward Min-Jae; his pitch-black eyes look completely cold, predatory, devoid of human recognition.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhire-dhire apna seeng wala sir min-je ki or ghumata hai; uski kali-kali aankhen puri tarah se thandi, hinsak, manviya pehchan se rahit dikhti han.

panels.action: The condensed hellfire sphere in Ha-Jun's gauntlet unconsciously swivels, aiming directly at Min-Jae's chest!
panels.prose_en: The condensed hellfire sphere in Ha-Jun's gauntlet unconsciously swivels, aiming directly at Min-Jae's chest!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki bandook mein sanghanit narkankaal ka gola anjane mein ghumta hai, jiska lakshya sidhe min-je ki chhati hai!

panels.action: Min-Jae trembles violently but doesn't run: 'Ha-Jun... yaad karo tum kaun ho! Apne bhai ke vaade ko yaad karo!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: APNE BHAI KE VAADE KO YAAD KARO!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae trembles violently but doesn't run: 'Ha-Jun... yaad karo tum kaun ho! Apne bhai ke vaade ko yaad karo!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je jor se kampta hai lekin bhagta nahin hai: 'ha-jun... yaad karo tum kaun ho! apne bhai ke vaade ko yaad karo!!'

panels.action: Extreme close-up: At the word 'Bhai', Ha-Jun's crimson rings violently contract; a jolt of human agony rips through his soul.
panels.prose_en: Extreme close-up: At the word 'Bhai', Ha-Jun's crimson rings violently contract; a jolt of human agony rips through his soul.
panels.prose_hi: Atyadhik clos-up: 'bhai' shabd par, ha-jun ki lal rang ki anguthiyan hinsak roop se sikud jaati han; manviya peeda ka ek jhatka uski aatma ko cheer deta hai.

panels.action: Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human self grabs the burning bloodline core with both hands, pulling it away from the abyss.
panels.prose_en: Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human self grabs the burning bloodline core with both hands, pulling it away from the abyss.
panels.prose_hi: Uske dimag ke ander, ha-jun ka manviya aatm donon hathon se jalti hui raktarekha ko pakad leta hai, aur use rasatal se door khinch leta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun wrenches his gauntlet straight up toward the heavens, unleashing the hellfire sphere in a colossal vertical laser pillar!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wrenches his gauntlet straight up toward the heavens, unleashing the hellfire sphere in a colossal vertical laser pillar!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sidhe swarg ki or apna hathiyar ghumata hai, aur ek vishal udhrvadhar laser stambh mein narkankaal ke gole ko khol deta hai!

panels.shot: purification dome shattering golden glass rain
panels.action: The hellfire pillar pierces the golden Anti-Demon Purification Dome above the university, shattering the entire barrier into rain of golden glass shards.
panels.prose_en: The hellfire pillar pierces the golden Anti-Demon Purification Dome above the university, shattering the entire barrier into rain of golden glass shards.
panels.prose_hi: Narkankal stambh vishwavidyalaya ke upar swarn-virodhi danav shuddhi gumbad ko chhedata hai, jisse puri badha sunhare kaanch ke tukdon ki baarish mein bikhar jaati hai.

panels.shot: obsidian horns dissolving back into skull
panels.action: The razor obsidian horns dissolve into violet smoke; the crystalline scales sink back beneath Ha-Jun's pale, trembling human skin.
panels.prose_en: The razor obsidian horns dissolve into violet smoke; the crystalline scales sink back beneath Ha-Jun's pale, trembling human skin.
panels.prose_hi: Rezar obsidian horn baingani dhuen mein ghul jaate han; crystaliy tarazu ha-jun ki pili, kampati manav tvacha ke neeche wapas doob jaate han.

panels.shot: collapsing on knees brown eyes return
panels.action: Ha-Jun collapses onto his knees on the cracked court, gasping in breathless exhaustion as his tired dark brown eyes return.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine... maine Min-Jae ko pehchan liya...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun collapses onto his knees on the cracked court, gasping in breathless exhaustion as his tired dark brown eyes return.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun toote hue court par apne ghutnon ke bal gir jata hai, aur uski thaki hui gahri bhuri aankhen wapas lautate hi wah bedam thakavat mein hanefane lagta hai.

panels.shot: masked watcher on library roof cliffhanger
panels.action: From the roof of the 10-story university library, a mysterious figure in a crimson demon mask and black cloak watches Ha-Jun with a sinister smile: 'Asmodaius ka beej... aakhir kaar poori tarah jaag gaya.'

dialogue.text: Asmodaius ka beej... aakhir kaar jaag gaya.

panels.prose_en: From the roof of the 10-story university library, a mysterious figure in a crimson demon mask and black cloak watches Ha-Jun with a sinister smile: 'Asmodaius ka beej... aakhir kaar poori tarah jaag gaya.'.
panels.prose_hi: 10 manjila university library ki chhat se, gahre lal danav mukhaute aur kale labade mein ek rahasyamayi aakriti ha-jun ko ek bhayavah muskan ke saath dekhti hai: 'asmodius ka bij... aakhir kar puri tarah jaag gaya.'
